shots.detail_en: Dawn: Changhong tears the archive envelope open — it is empty, only a slip of paper slides out reading 'Do the work first.'
shots.sub: 熊天成……
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Changhong folds the empty envelope into a small square and tucks it into his jacket, eyes going cold.
shots.sub: 父亲说盘口会说谎——原来袋子也会。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Market opens: the split-flap board shows 'Lianhua XX' red and green blocks rising and falling (abstract board).
Three-day guarding montage: the alliance watching volume in split lines / cigar smoke in the VIP room / Changhong re-drawing charts late at night (methods blurred — people only, no orders shown).
shots.sub: 旁白：护到第三天，我才看懂——他不是要我护，他是在试我。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Mid-session volume spikes; red blocks get eaten layer by layer (abstract diagram).
shots.sub: 不对……这量，不是散户的量。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: In the VIP box, Xiong Tiancheng raises his glass behind the glass wall, toasting Changhong from afar; his voice off-screen.
shots.sub: 熊（画外）：年轻人，接稳了。
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: Reversal: Changhong reads the board structure — his guarding position sits right beneath the exit gate (red blocks sinking diagram).
shots.sub: 我不是护盘——我是他出货的垫子！
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Changhong rises and signals; the alliance withdraws in order (Man Cang leading the small retail crowd, panicked but orderly).
shots.sub: 散！按次序，别回头！
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Man Cang blocks him in a hurry.
shots.sub: 撤了三天就白干了！兄弟们全仓等分红呢——全仓啊！
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Changhong grabs Man Cang by the collar and shouts at him for the first time.
shots.sub: 人比仓重要！
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Withdrawals flow back like water; the alliance position area empties (abstract light stream).
shots.sub: 旁白：成交量不会说谎——它告诉我，谁在门口等着收骨头。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Blast point: at close a giant sell volume slams down, a sea of green floods the board — the cushion spot is empty, the blow hits nothing.
shots.sub: 满仓：我的妈……要是不撤……
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: In the VIP box Xiong Tiancheng puts away his smile and slowly lowers his binoculars.
shots.sub: 熊：撤了？……老陆当年，可没撤过。
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: Changhong clenches his fist toward the VIP box.
shots.sub: 三天到了。档案。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Top-floor office: Xiong slides the real archive box across the desk, his palm pressing on it, not letting go.
shots.sub: 熊：垫子没当成，但你护住了你的人。我记你一分。档案嘛……
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: The archive box opens: the June 17, 1993 ledger page, its key line cut away — mirror image of the missing line in father's notebook.
shots.sub: 长：又缺一行。 熊：缺的那行，在我脑子里。
shots.speaker: CH+XIONG

shots.detail_en: Changhong shuts the box and turns away.
shots.sub: 长：你到底想把我变成什么？ 熊：山顶的椅子，一直空着半边。
shots.speaker: CH+XIONG

shots.detail_en: In the stairwell Man Cang catches up carrying the iron box.
shots.sub: 满仓：长虹！我爹听说了这三天的事——非让我把这六万送来，他说这钱跟你干，值！
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Changhong's hand rests on the deposit slips for three seconds; red-board light from the window stains the paper.
shots.sub: ……算我借的。三天。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Behind the counter, Hongli watches Changhong accept the iron box; her pen stops dead on the ledger page.
shots.sub: 红：他把不该收的钱，收进了同一本账。
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Late-night hall: the sixty thousand merges into the capital pool, shrinking to one tiny cell on the screen.
shots.sub: 旁白：六万块进了池子——像一滴血，进了海。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Black frame end card for next episode.
shots.sub: 满仓爹数着日子等利息——他不知道，钱已经上了别人的战场。
shots.card: 满仓爹数着日子等利息——他不知道，钱已经上了别人的战场。
